text.hi: cloth = कपड़ा (थान), clothes = पहनने के कपड़े। elder = परिवार में बड़ा, older = उम्र में ज़्यादा। child-like = बच्चे जैसा भोला (अच्छा), childish = बचकाना (बुरा)। adapt = ढल जाना, adopt = अपना लेना।
text.hinglish: cloth = kapda (thaan), clothes = pehenne ke kapde. elder = parivaar mein bada, older = umar mein zyaada. child-like = bachche jaisa bhola (achha), childish = bachkaana (bura). adapt = dhal jaana, adopt = apna lena.
text.en: cloth = material, clothes = what we wear. elder = senior in a family, older = more in age. child-like = innocent (good), childish = silly (bad). adapt = adjust to, adopt = take as your own.

meaning.hi: कपड़े (पहनने वाले) कपड़े (थान) से बनते हैं।
meaning.hinglish: Kapde (pehenne waale) kapde (thaan) se bante hain.

steps.sentence: My ___ brother obviously is older than me.

meaning.hi: मेरा बड़ा भाई ज़ाहिर है मुझसे उम्र में बड़ा है।
meaning.hinglish: Mera bada bhai zaahir hai mujhse umar mein bada hai.
